title: NEX trusted native module bundle

path.description: Strict UTF-8 relative path, at most 128 components, each at most 255 bytes; no empty, dot or dot-dot components, backslash, colon or NUL. Runtime also checks byte lengths and prefix conflicts.

description: Pin the exact manifest UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256. Entry and notice paths must occur uniquely in files. File contents are checked before initialization. The loader enforces the additional graph, byte and filesystem rules. This is host metadata and does not enable source extern declarations.
